description: Rewire both send paths to per-number decrypted credentials (preserving all existing behavior), replace/neutralize the fake verify/confirm/bare-POST endpoints, serialize number reads to strip the token, and replace the frontend fake-code flow with the two real Connect paths surfacing real Meta statuses (fixes 'sent but not received' via per-tenant creds, 'code_verification_status not visible', and 'how the number connects without asking IDs'). Depends on FEAT-001 (helpers) and FEAT-002 (onboarding endpoints the frontend posts to).
steps: Modify src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts: replace the inline `const phoneNumberId = number.phoneNumberId ?? process.env.META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID; const accessToken = process.env.META_ACCESS_TOKEN;` with `let phoneNumberId=null,accessToken=null;` then `try { ({ phoneNumberId, accessToken } = resolveSendCredentials(number)); } catch { console.error('[Send] credential resolution failed (encryption/config)'); phoneNumberId=null; accessToken=null; }` (import resolveSendCredentials from '@/lib/whatsapp'). Because both are null on throw, the pre-existing `if (!phoneNumberId || !accessToken)` branch sets finalStatus='failed' and the end-of-handler refund runs. PRESERVE EXACTLY: auth guard; number verified + template approved checks; the auth-template OTP guard (category==='authentication' && !variables?.[0] -> 400) BEFORE message.create and credit deduct; the #131008 button component ({ type:'button', sub_type:'url', index:'0', parameters:[{type:'text',text:vars[0]}] }); credit deduct on send / refund on failure; superadmin exemption; message.create -> update with metaMessageId/status/errorMessage; Graph v19.0; recipient digit-stripping; response shapes.

Modify src/app/api/chat/[contactPhone]/send/route.ts: replace the inline env fallback with `let phoneNumberId=null,accessToken=null; try { ({ phoneNumberId, accessToken } = resolveSendCredentials(waNumber)); } catch { phoneNumberId=null; accessToken=null; }` so the existing `if (!phoneNumberId || !accessToken) return 500 'Meta API credentials not configured'` fires BEFORE any message.create. Preserve the conversation upsert, free-text payload, message.create, 422-on-Meta-failure and 500-on-missing-creds shapes, Graph v19.0.

Modify src/app/api/numbers/[id]/verify/route.ts: remove the random 6-digit code generation entirely. Repurpose to a real health refresh — load the session user's number (scoped by userId); if it has a stored accessToken, GET /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,status with the decrypted token (via resolveSendCredentials) and update displayPhoneNumber/verifiedName/qualityRating/codeVerificationStatus/platformType; if no token (legacy) return 400 'Reconnect this number via Connect WhatsApp'. Respond serializeNumber(updated).

Modify src/app/api/numbers/[id]/confirm/route.ts: neutralize to return 410 { error: 'Manual code confirmation is no longer supported. Connect via Embedded Signup or manual credentials.' } (keep auth guard; never mark a number verified from a local code).

Modify src/app/api/numbers/route.ts: keep GET but map each row through serializeNumber; change POST so a bare phoneNumber is rejected with 400 directing the user to the two real paths (no usable/verified number minted).
Modify src/app/api/numbers/[id]/route.ts: GET returns serializeNumber(number); keep DELETE unchanged.

Modify src/app/dashboard/numbers/add/page.tsx into the Connect page: a 'Connect WhatsApp' button that injects the FB JS SDK once (https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/sdk.js), FB.init({ appId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID, autoLogAppEvents: true, xfbml: false, version: 'v19.0' }), registers an origin-guarded window 'message' listener (accept only https://www.facebook.com / https://web.facebook.com) capturing WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP phone_number_id/waba_id, and on click calls FB.login(cb, { config_id: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID, response_type: 'code', override_default_response_type: true, extras: { setup: {}, featureType: '', sessionInfoVersion: '3' } }) then POSTs { code, phoneNumberId?, wabaId? } to /api/numbers/embedded-signup; plus an 'Enter credentials manually' toggle revealing a form (WABA ID, Phone Number ID, Access Token, optional label) POSTing to /api/numbers/manual and showing Meta's exact 400 message. Remove the old phone-string registration form. On success refresh/redirect to the numbers list; on cancel/failure show an inline error.
Modify src/app/dashboard/numbers/[id]/verify/page.tsx: delete the OTP/dev-code UI and make it a pure client redirect to /dashboard/numbers/[id].

Modify src/app/dashboard/numbers/page.tsx: keep the list + DELETE working; extend the WhatsAppNumber interface with the new optional fields and render connectionType / real statuses in the badge where available.

Modify src/app/dashboard/numbers/[id]/page.tsx: extend the WhatsAppNumber interface with the new optional fields; surface displayPhoneNumber, verifiedName, qualityRating, codeVerificationStatus, platformType, connectionType rendered conditionally; add the SINGLE 'Refresh status' button that POSTs /api/numbers/[id]/verify and re-renders. Remove the old 'Continue Verification' link path.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with all modified routes and pages type-checking, including the extended client WhatsAppNumber interfaces and NEXT_PUBLIC_* usage (AC #1).

messages/send: the auth-template OTP guard still precedes message.create and credit deduction; the #131008 button component is still appended; credit is deducted on send and refunded on failure; superadmin is not charged; a decrypt/credential throw funnels into the failed+refund branch (not a stuck queued row) (AC #10, #11).
chat/[contactPhone]/send uses resolveSendCredentials with the missing-creds 500 firing before any message.create (AC #12).
The fake 6-digit flow is gone: verify generates no random code and confirm cannot mark a number verified from a local code (returns 410) (AC #14).
Every number read response (GET list, GET detail, both POSTs, the verify refresh) passes through serializeNumber so no plaintext/ciphertext token leaves the server (AC #8).
The number detail page surfaces the real codeVerificationStatus and related Meta status fields for a connected number (AC #17).
verification: Re-read the diff of src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts to confirm the OTP guard order, #131008 button, deduct/refund, superadmin exemption, and metaMessageId capture are byte-for-byte preserved except the credential-resolution swap; confirm the throw path leaves both creds null (needs runtime verification for a live send — fixes the user's 'sent but not received' via per-tenant creds; do NOT dismiss as already-working from code alone).
Read src/app/api/chat/[contactPhone]/send/route.ts to confirm the missing-creds 500 precedes message.create.

Read the numbers API + pages to confirm serializeNumber everywhere, the 410 confirm, the no-random-code verify refresh, and that the detail page renders codeVerificationStatus/connectionType conditionally (live FB popup is needs-runtime-verification with a user-supplied Config ID).
findings:
COMPLETED. `npm run build` passes clean (the DYNAMIC_SERVER_USAGE logs during static generation are pre-existing/unrelated, same as FEAT-001 noted). All send-path behavior preserved byte-for-byte except the credential swap. Graph v19.0 everywhere; no tokens logged or returned.

SEND PATHS (both now use resolveSendCredentials from '@/lib/whatsapp'):
- src/app/api/messages/send/route.ts: replaced the two inline env assignments with `let phoneNumberId: string|null=null, accessToken: string|null=null; try { ({phoneNumberId,accessToken}=resolveSendCredentials(number)); } catch { console.error('[Send] credential resolution failed (encryption/config)'); phoneNumberId=null; accessToken=null; }`. The swap sits AFTER the credit deduct and BEFORE the pre-existing `if (!phoneNumberId || !accessToken)` branch, so a decrypt/config throw -> both null -> finalStatus='failed' + end-of-handler refund (not a stuck 'queued' row). PRESERVED EXACTLY (re-read & confirmed): auth guard; verified-number + approved-template checks; the auth-template OTP guard (category==='authentication' && !variables?.[0] -> 400) still BEFORE message.create and deduct; the #131008 button component ({type:'button',sub_type:'url',index:'0',parameters:[{type:'text',text:vars[0]}]}); deduct-on-send / refund-on-failure; superadmin exemption (isSuperAdmin = role==='superadmin', not charged, not refunded); message.create('queued') -> update with metaMessageId/status/sentAt/errorMessage; recipient.replace(/\D/g,''); response shapes {id,status:'sent',message} and {error} 500.
- src/app/api/chat/[contactPhone]/send/route.ts: same try/catch swap on waNumber. The existing `if (!phoneNumberId||!accessToken) -> 500 'Meta API credentials not configured'` now fires BEFORE the Meta fetch and BEFORE message.create. Preserved: conversation.upsert, free-text payload (type:'text'), message.create, 422-on-Meta-failure {error,message}, 500-on-missing-creds, Graph v19.0.

NUMBERS CRUD / HEALTH:
- src/app/api/numbers/[id]/verify/route.ts: fully repurposed. NO random code. Loads the session user's number (scoped by userId); if number.accessToken===null -> 400 'Reconnect this number via Connect WhatsApp'; else resolveSendCredentials (its own try/catch -> 400 reconnect on throw or null creds), GET /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,status with the decrypted bearer; non-OK -> 400 with Meta's error.message; on OK, update displayPhoneNumber/verifiedName/qualityRating/codeVerificationStatus/platformType and respond serializeNumber(updated). Does NOT touch verificationStatus.
- src/app/api/numbers/[id]/confirm/route.ts: neutralized. Keeps the auth guard (401 without session.user.id), then always returns 410 {error:'Manual code confirmation is no longer supported. Connect via Embedded Signup or manual credentials.'}. Never marks verified. (Signature is POST() — params/body no longer read.)
- src/app/api/numbers/route.ts: GET maps every row through serializeNumber. POST is now POST() (no body) and always returns 400 directing the user to /api/numbers/embedded-signup or /api/numbers/manual (keeps auth guard; mints nothing).
- src/app/api/numbers/[id]/route.ts: GET returns serializeNumber(number); DELETE unchanged.

FRONTEND (4 pages):
- src/app/dashboard/numbers/add/page.tsx: rebuilt as the Connect page. Injects the FB JS SDK once (script id 'facebook-jssdk', https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/sdk.js), FB.init({appId: NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID, autoLogAppEvents:true, xfbml:false, version:'v19.0'}) via fbAsyncInit; origin-guarded window 'message' listener accepts only https://www.facebook.com / https://web.facebook.com and captures WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP data.phone_number_id/data.waba_id into a ref. 'Connect WhatsApp' button calls FB.login(cb,{config_id: NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID, response_type:'code', override_default_response_type:true, extras:{setup:{},featureType:'',sessionInfoVersion:'3'}}) and on code POSTs {code,phoneNumberId?,wabaId?} to /api/numbers/embedded-signup. 'Enter credentials manually' toggle reveals a form (WABA ID, Phone Number ID, Access Token [password], optional label) POSTing to /api/numbers/manual and surfacing Meta's exact 400 message via data.error. Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID/CONFIG_ID -> inline guidance to use manual. Old phone-string form removed. On success router.push('/dashboard/numbers')+refresh.
- src/app/dashboard/numbers/[id]/verify/page.tsx: OTP/dev-code UI deleted; now a pure client redirect (router.replace) to /dashboard/numbers/[id] with a spinner.
- src/app/dashboard/numbers/page.tsx: list + DELETE kept. WhatsAppNumber interface extended with optional connectionType/displayPhoneNumber/verifiedName/qualityRating/codeVerificationStatus/platformType. Renders displayPhoneNumber||phoneNumber, the connectionType label in the subline, and a codeVerificationStatus outline badge when present.
- src/app/dashboard/numbers/[id]/page.tsx: interface extended likewise. Surfaces displayPhoneNumber, connectionType, verifiedName, codeVerificationStatus, qualityRating, platformType conditionally. Single 'Refresh status' button POSTs /api/numbers/[id]/verify and re-renders with the serialized result (inline error on failure). Old 'Continue Verification' link removed.

NEXT_PUBLIC_* USED BY FRONTEND (FEAT-004 must document in .env.example): NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID. Server env already in use by the onboarding/send/health routes: META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, META_CONFIG_ID (user-supplied), ENCRYPTION_KEY, META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, and the legacy fallback META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID/META_ACCESS_TOKEN (used only when a number row has no stored token).

VERIFICATION: `npm run build` passes (exit 0, all modified routes/pages type-check incl. the extended client interfaces + NEXT_PUBLIC_* usage). Re-read of the messages/send diff confirms OTP guard order, #131008 button, deduct/refund, superadmin exemption, and metaMessageId capture are byte-for-byte preserved except the credential swap; the throw path leaves both creds null. chat/send 500 confirmed to precede message.create. NEEDS RUNTIME VERIFICATION (not provable from code — do NOT dismiss as already-working): a live template send proving per-tenant creds fix the user's 'sent but not received'; the FB Embedded Signup popup end-to-end (needs user-supplied Config ID + App Review + real token); and the health-refresh Graph call.
